subject: Hosting options & data residency — follow-up from demo
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-05T09:12:00-05:00
Subject: Hosting options & data residency — follow-up from demo

Hi Marta — thanks for the time today. Quick recap and the asks we said we'd follow up on: 

What I heard: 
- Primary requirement: all customer PII and transaction data must remain in the EU (no cross-border routing of EU customer data).
- Secondary workload (analytics/aggregates) can run in APAC if needed, but needs an explicit data flow diagram and DPA addendum.
- Preferred regions mentioned: Frankfurt (eu-central) for EU, Singapore (ap-southeast) for APAC.

Immediate questions for your compliance/procurement team: 
- Is the requirement a strict in-country (Germany) residency, or is EU-only (any EU data center) sufficient?
- Would you consider Redwood Dedicated (reserved GPU capacity) vs Private VPC if the deciding factor is physical tenant isolation?

Attachments: redwood-residency-matrix.xlsx (rough mapping of Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private for EU/APAC scenarios).

Proposed next steps: 
1) You confirm whether EU-only vs Germany-only is the requirement (one-line reply is fine).
2) If EU-only acceptable, we can validate Hosted API availability in Frankfurt and share estimated unit costs.
3) If Germany-only or you require VPC/on-prem, we can provide a Private deployment SOW and timeline (ETA: 6–8 weeks typical for VPC onboarding).
4) Schedule a 45-min technical deep dive w/ your infra & security team — I added a couple of slot options below.

Suggested slots: Thu 11/7 10:00–10:45 CET or Fri 11/8 14:00–14:45 CET (I can re-time to your TZ).

Thanks — I’ll loop in Laura and Camila on compliance details once we hear back.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0191

Attachment: redwood-residency-matrix.xlsx (see tab 'EU vs APAC summary')

From: Marta Kovac <marta.kovac@aureafinancial.eu>

Cc: Oliver Schmidt <oliver.schmidt@aureafinancial.eu>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-05T11:03:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Hosting options & data residency — follow-up from demo

Hi Ben — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- EU requirement: strictly EU-only is acceptable for initial MVP, but for full-prod (payment/settlement flows) we need in-country (Germany) residency. Our legal team will confirm the exact language but plan for Germany-only for the high-sensitivity flows.
- Physical isolation: if the Dedicated option guarantees physical isolation (no co-tenant GPUs/hosts) and a dedicated network path, that will satisfy a number of our auditors. If not, we will need Private VPC.
- Timeline: procurement is tight — we aim to finalize vendor selection by the end of Q1 2027.

Oliver (secops) will join the technical deep dive. He may also send a short questionnaire (SOC2 + encryption + key management).

Would it be possible to get a side-by-side Hosted vs Dedicated cost delta for Frankfurt with assumptions on throughput (100 rps, median latency 120ms)? Also, can you confirm whether Hosted tokens for EU customers would ever route through a non-EU cache in failure scenarios? That is a hard blocker for some of our flows.

Appreciate it — please cc Oliver on the next message.

Regards,
Marta
Head of Payments Integration | Aurea Financial
marta.kovac@aureafinancial.eu

Hi Marta / Oliver — thanks for the fast reply and for outlining the Germany requirement. Quick answers and next steps below. 

Short answers: 
- Hosted routing: by default Hosted API for EU customers will serve from the nearest EU region (Frankfurt) and we have an explicit geo-pin option to prevent cross-region cache fallback for an account. I can get the exact policy doc from infra but short version: we can prevent non-EU egress for account-scoped traffic.
- Dedicated in Frankfurt: we can offer Dedicated capacity with host tenancy (no co-tenancy on physical hosts) in eu-central by exception — we will need to confirm capacity but are prepared to include this in the proposal.
- Private VPC: still available if you require fully customer-controlled network & KMS/HSM. Typical onboarding 6–8 weeks after SOW sign.

Requested deliverables attached: sow-dedicated-trial.pdf (30-day trial SOW for Dedicated), redwood-residency-matrix.xlsx (updated with Germany-only vs EU scenarios). Also included a short cost-delta note (see Drive link).

Next steps: 
1) Tech deep dive — propose Tue 11/10 09:00–09:45 CET (I created calendar event: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/8b3f-hosting-deep-dive). 
2) I'll share a Hosted vs Dedicated cost delta for Frankfurt by EOD 11/06 (assumptions: 100 rps sustained, median 120ms).
3) Oliver: if your team can send the SOC2 + KMS questions ahead of the call that would help prioritize the SRE/infra attendees.
